summary: Invoice credits appear then disappear after hourly postback replay ("ghosting")
description:
Issue summary:
BrightCart reports that a provisional invoice generated on 2026-03-09 showed expected hourly buffer credits applied, then a subsequent finalized invoice (2026-03-09 23:59 UTC) shows those same credits missing. Customer observed the credits briefly in the billing UI after an automated postback replay, then the credits vanished ('ghosting').

Impact:
- Customer provisional invoice temporarily correct, then final invoice charged ~USD 3,200 higher than expected.
- Customer-facing finance team opened a dispute.
- Customer on enterprise contract with reserved capacity; expected credits for hourly buffer and kv-cache warmups are material to their month-end reconciliation.

Environment:
- prod-us-east primary; some postbacks routed through eu-west during replay window.
- Affected tenant: brightcart-prod (org-id: org_0BRCX)

Steps to reproduce (approx):
1) Trigger a scheduled hourly postback replay job for a batched embed job (microbatching: true) spanning 2026-03-09 18:00-20:00 UTC.
2) Observe postback-audit logs showing credit lines applied at 2026-03-09T18:05:12Z.
3) Wait for reconciler pass and provisional invoice generation (2026-03-09T19:00Z) - credits visible in UI.
4) Replayer attempts a second replay (retry window) around 2026-03-09T21:45Z; reconciler picks up reordered postbacks and later finalized invoice (23:59 UTC) shows credits missing.

Logs / Observations:
- postback-replayer logs (job 20260309-replay-77): shows duplicate postback IDs without idempotency tokens for ~4k postbacks.
- billing-engine trace: credit application events present in provisional run id: prov_20260309_19 but missing in finalized run final_20260309_2359.
- reconciler metrics: increased out-of-order postbacks metric around 21:30-22:00 UTC.
- Slack thread: #support (link: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C04SUPPORT/p164) contains customer screenshots.

Hypothesis:
- Postback replay reorders events; replayer attempt lost idempotency header for replayed postbacks older than retention threshold, causing reconciler to classify them as "stale" and skip credit re-application during finalization. The provisional invoice included credits when initial reconciler pass caught them; the finalizer pass used a different ordering and dropped the lines.

Immediate impact mitigation attempted:
- Temporarily re-applied missing credits manually to the account ledger as a provisional credit hold (billing-engine patch) to prevent autopay from charging the customer while we investigate.
- Contacted accounting to hold final invoice settlement for org_0BRCX.

Requested by customer:
- Immediate correction on the finalized invoice or a one-time credit and confirmation of a permanent fix to prevent recurrence.
comments: 2026-03-10 | Lina Park (Customer): We saw the credits for ~10 minutes in the billing UI, then they disappeared from the finalized invoice. Our finance team is escalating — can you confirm this won’t auto-charge?

2026-03-10 | Diego Martinez (Support): We've placed an invoice hold and started an investigation. Can you share any screenshot of the provisional invoice and the finalized invoice? Also please confirm the org id and any API keys used for the batch job.
2026-03-10 | Lina Park (Customer): Screenshots uploaded to support ticket and linked Slack thread. Org ID: org_0BRCX. Job id: embed-batch-20260309-18. Keys: scoped to prod.
2026-03-11 | Diego Martinez (Support): Engineering triage underway. Early signal points to replayed postbacks missing idempotency header. Escalating to billing-engine and postback-reconciler owners.
2026-03-11 | Priya Kapoor (Billing): Confirmed manual provisional-credit re-apply done at 2026-03-11T09:12:43Z. Awaiting reconciler logs for finalization window.

2026-03-12 | Marco Alvarez (Reconciler): Found replay job that stripped X-Idempotency when proxying to ingest service when replay=true. Patch PR created: https://github.com/redwood/usage-reconciler/pull/482 — needs deploy and a backfill script to reprocess affected runs.
2026-03-13 | Diego Martinez (Support): Notified customer that we will issue an invoice adjustment and a one-time credit while fix deploys. Next update after PR deployment and backfill completion.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11 — Reproducer: Ran a controlled replay in staging similar to customer time window. Observed same behavior when X-Idempotency header omitted: reconciler ignored duplicate postbacks leading to missing credit lines.

2026-03-11 — Root cause candidate: recent replayer refactor (release 2026-03-02) introduced an optimization that strips forwarding headers unless replay_mode=stream. Edge case: batched replay sets replay_mode=batch and lost header.
2026-03-12 — Impact estimate: scanning prod logs for 2026-03-08 -> 2026-03-10 shows ~12 tenant jobs with similar pattern; BrightCart is highest-dollar affected (~USD 3.2k).
2026-03-12 — Mitigation: manual ledger re-apply performed and invoice hold placed. Patch to replayer to preserve idempotency header in all replay modes prepared and code-reviewed.

2026-03-12 — Backfill plan: run a safe reprocess job for affected windows using reconciler backfill tool; will mark reconciled events with backfill-tag and produce audit report for accounting. Estimated runtime: 4 hours for identified windows.
2026-03-13 — Monitoring: added a temporary alert (postback-replay/idempotency-missing > 1/min) and a dashboard tile showing credits-applied vs credits-finalized per tenant for the last 48h.
resolution_notes:
Workaround and resolution plan: 1) Manual provisional credit re-apply completed for BrightCart and accounting hold placed on the disputed invoice (2026-03-11). 2) Hotfix PR merged to preserve idempotency headers for all replay modes and deployed to prod cluster on 2026-03-13. 3) Reconciler backfill job executed for affected windows (2026-03-09 18:00-22:00 UTC); ledger audit confirms credits re-applied and final invoice adjusted. 4) Customer invoice adjusted and Finance issued a credit memo for USD 3,200 on 2026-03-13; customer notified and confirmed receipt.

Follow-ups assigned: INT-33027 (postmortem + runbook update), engineering task to add unit tests preventing header-stripping regressions, and a billing audit to run hourly for one week to ensure no recurrence.
